title: Koala in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='30' r='14' fill='#b8b8c8'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='30' r='14' fill='#b8b8c8'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='30' r='9' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='30' r='9' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='27' ry='24' fill='#c8c8d8'/>
  <!-- Face lighter patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='17' ry='15' fill='#e0e0ec'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='37' r='4.5' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='37' r='4.5' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='35.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='35.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#3a3a5a'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='46.5' rx='1.6' ry='1.2' fill='#8a8ab0'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M44 54 Q50 58 56 54' stroke='#6a6a8a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#c8c8d8'/>
  <!-- Little arms -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='78' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#b8b8c8'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='78' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#b8b8c8'/>
  <!-- Scarf band -->
  <path d='M28 64 Q50 72 72 64 L72 70 Q50 78 28 70 Z' fill='#e8503a'/>
  <!-- Scarf tail -->
  <path d='M66 68 L74 82 L66 84 L62 70 Z' fill='#f06040'/>
  <path d='M66 70 L72 82' stroke='#c8402a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Scarf stripe highlight -->
  <path d='M30 66 Q50 73 70 66' stroke='#ff8060' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
